fault_confinement_states.name: error active
fault_confinement_states.description: ECR.TEC < 128 AND ECR.REC < 128. Can take part in bus communication; sends ACTIVE ERROR FLAG (6 dominant bits).

fault_confinement_states.name: error passive
fault_confinement_states.description: ECR.TEC ≥ 128 OR ECR.REC ≥ 128. PSR.EP = 1. Sends PASSIVE ERROR FLAG (6 recessive bits); must wait SUSPEND TRANSMISSION before next transmission. In CAN FD, ESI in transmitted FD frame is recessive.

fault_confinement_states.name: bus off
fault_confinement_states.description: ECR.TEC = 256. PSR.BO = 1; output drivers off. Recovers to error-active after 129 occurrences of Bus_Idle (129 × 11 consecutive recessive bits) after CCCR.INIT is cleared by the CPU. CCCR.INIT is set automatically on bus-off entry.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_BUS_IDLE
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Wait for Bus_Idle (≥ 11 consecutive recessive bits).

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_ARBITRATION
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Send IDENTIFIER + RTR (Classical) or RRS (FD); monitor bus.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_CONTROL_FD
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: (FD) Send r1, FDF=1, res=0, BRS, ESI, DLC[3:0]. At BRS=1 bit: switch to DBTP rate.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_DATA
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Send DATA FIELD (0..64 bytes per DLC).

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_STUFF_CNT
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: (FD/ISO only) Send 3-bit stuff-count + 1-bit parity before CRC sequence.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_CRC
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Send CRC SEQUENCE (15 / 17 / 21 bit) + recessive CRC DELIMITER.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_BRS_OFF
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: (FD with BRS=1) At CRC delimiter: switch back to NBTP rate.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_ACK_SLOT
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Drive recessive on ACK SLOT; sample bus.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_EOF
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: Drive 7 recessive bits as END OF FRAME.

fsm_hints_transmitter.name: TX_SUSPEND
fsm_hints_transmitter.description: (error-passive only) Drive 8 recessive SUSPEND TRANSMISSION bits.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_BUS_IDLE
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Wait for dominant bit (= START OF FRAME).

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_HARD_SYNC
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Hard-synchronize internal bit time to SOF edge. If CCCR.EFBI = 1, require 2 consecutive dominant tq.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_ARBITRATION
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Sample IDENTIFIER + RTR/RRS + IDE + extended bits.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_FDF_DETECT
fsm_hints_receiver.description: At FDF bit: dominant → Classical path; recessive → FD path. FDF=1 + res=1: Protocol Exception → PSR.PXE.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_BRS_DETECT
fsm_hints_receiver.description: (FD only) At BRS bit: if BRS=1, switch to DBTP bit time + use SSP for bit error check.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_DATA_COLLECT
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Receive DATA FIELD per DLC encoding.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_CRC_CHECK
fsm_hints_receiver.description: Compute CRC (15/17/21-bit per format + payload size); compare with received + stuff-count parity (ISO).

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_ACK_GEN
fsm_hints_receiver.description: If CRC matched, drive dominant during ACK SLOT.

fsm_hints_receiver.name: RX_VALIDATE
fsm_hints_receiver.description: If no error up to the last-but-one bit of EOF, deliver via Acceptance Filter → Rx Buffer / Rx FIFO.

synchronization_rules: Only one SYNCHRONIZATION within one bit time is allowed.
An edge is used for SYNCHRONIZATION only if the value detected at the previous SAMPLE POINT differs from the bus value immediately after the edge.
HARD SYNCHRONIZATION is performed on the recessive-to-dominant edge during BUS IDLE.
RESYNCHRONIZATION jump width: NSJW[6:0]+1 tq in arbitration phase; DSJW[3:0]+1 tq in data phase.
Edge filtering during bus integration: CCCR.EFBI = 1 requires 2 consecutive dominant tq.
Information Processing Time (IPT) is zero in M_CAN.
In CAN FD data phase the bit error check uses the Secondary Sample Point (SSP) when TDC is enabled.
arbitration_rule: Bitwise on ARBITRATION FIELD (IDENTIFIER + RTR/RRS). Each transmitter compares its driven bit to the monitored bus level. Recessive driven + dominant monitored → arbitration lost. M_CAN's Tx Handler scans all Tx Buffers + selects message with lowest IDENTIFIER before each tx slot.
anti_deadlock_rule: Multimaster arbitration is non-blocking. Fault confinement (error-passive / bus-off) prevents a single defective node from blocking the bus. M_CAN's transmit pause (CCCR.TXP = 1) further smooths out burst transmissions.
exit_from_reset_or_wakeup: After hardware reset CCCR.INIT = 1, m_can_tx = recessive. After CPU clears CCCR.INIT, the Bit Stream Processor waits for 11 consecutive recessive bits before joining bus activities. From Sleep Mode: deassert m_can_clkstop_req; M_CAN resets m_can_clkstop_ack + CCCR.CSA; CPU resets CCCR.INIT.
default_signal_state_when_bus_free: Bus idle = all nodes drive recessive (= released). The M_CAN's m_can_tx is held recessive (HIGH) under CCCR.INIT = 1.
wake_up_message_identifier: CAN FD itself does not define a wake-up identifier at the protocol layer. M_CAN's clock-stop power-down mechanism is bus-activity agnostic at the protocol layer — wake-up is driven by m_can_clkstop_req deasserting.

operational_modes_fsm.name: INIT_SW
operational_modes_fsm.description: CCCR.INIT = 1. Bus transfer stopped. Configuration registers writable when CCCR.CCE also = 1.

operational_modes_fsm.name: NORMAL
operational_modes_fsm.description: CCCR.INIT cleared by CPU. BSP waits for 11 consecutive recessive bits then joins bus.

operational_modes_fsm.name: CAN_FD_OP
operational_modes_fsm.description: CCCR.FDOE = 1; FD-capable Tx Buffer elements transmit in CAN FD format.

operational_modes_fsm.name: BUS_MONITORING
operational_modes_fsm.description: CCCR.MON = 1. Receives valid frames + remote frames; cannot transmit dominant bits.

operational_modes_fsm.name: RESTRICTED_OP
operational_modes_fsm.description: CCCR.ASM = 1. Receives + sends ACK; does NOT send data/remote/error/overload frames.

operational_modes_fsm.name: SLEEP_REQ
operational_modes_fsm.description: m_can_clkstop_req or CCCR.CSR = 1. M_CAN waits for pending Tx + bus idle.

operational_modes_fsm.name: TEST_LBCK_EXT
operational_modes_fsm.description: TEST.LBCK = 1, CCCR.MON = 0. Tx looped back to Rx; ACK errors ignored.

operational_modes_fsm.name: TEST_LBCK_INT
operational_modes_fsm.description: TEST.LBCK = 1, CCCR.MON = 1. m_can_rx disconnected; m_can_tx forced recessive.

protected_write_unlock_sequence: 5. Clear CCCR.INIT — wait for INIT readback before any operation.
cccr_init_self_set_conditions: Uncorrected bit error read from Message RAM (IR.BEU = 1).
Power-down mode (m_can_clkstop_req or CCCR.CSR = 1) after pending Tx + bus idle.
fault_confinement_counter_rules: Receive Error Counter increments on receive errors per ISO 11898-1:2015 Section 12.
Transmit Error Counter increments on transmit errors.
TEC stops at 0xFF; REC stops at 0x7F.
When CCCR.ASM set: TEC + REC are frozen but CEL keeps counting.
CEL[7:0] = 8-bit counter incrementing once per CAN protocol error + once on Bus_Off entry. Overflow → IR.ELO.
rx_handler_state_machine: Acceptance Filter: applied after complete identifier received; sequential filter list scan; first matching enabled element wins.
Storage: per matched filter element's SFEC/EFEC: FIFO 0 / FIFO 1 / dedicated Rx Buffer / debug message A-C / reject / set-priority.
Rx FIFO Put Index advanced on store; blocking mode discards on full; overwrite mode overwrites oldest.
Dedicated Rx Buffer locked by New Data flag until host clears.
Sync message (filter SSYNC/ESYNC = 1 + CCCR.UTSU = 1) generates pulse at m_can_tsrx.
tx_handler_state_machine: Tx Scan triggered when TXBRP register changes.
Preload: first 4 RAM words of top 1-2 pending messages loaded.
Tx Slot: highest-priority preloaded message at next bus opportunity.
Tx FIFO: messages transmitted in put-order.
Tx Queue: messages transmitted by lowest Message ID.
Mixed Dedicated + FIFO / Queue: lowest ID wins.
Tx Cancellation: TXBCR bit → cancel buffer → TXBCF bit set.
Tx Event FIFO write on successful transmission (or successful-in-spite-of-cancellation in DAR mode) if Tx Buffer T1.EFC = 1.
